prompt: Can Copilot cloud agent approve and merge its own pull requests?
explanation: Per GitHub Docs, Copilot cloud agent cannot mark PRs Ready for review, approve, or merge them. Human review before merge is hard-coded — not configurable.

options.text: Yes, if all automated checks pass
Yes, if the repo owner enables auto-merge
No — Copilot cloud agent cannot mark its PRs as Ready for review, approve, or merge them; human review is always required
